messages:
maria: Hey folks — opened a PR to add a couple of observability improvements to the Console: dashboard widgets for endpoint latency/error-rate + a small tracing hook that attaches request_id. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2312

Summary: adds 2 dashboard panels, storybook for widgets, tracing hook middleware, and a tiny DB migration to add `request_meta` column. Unit tests + snapshots included. Need 2 approvals from eng-platform/observability to merge. Trying to land EOD if reviews are quick. Can someone take a look today? cc @tom @jae :pray:

tom: On it — will try to review before lunch. quick question: the migration looks like an `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` — do we need a rollout window or is it safe online? :thinking:

maria: It should be safe online — additive column with default NULL. Migration code uses `IF NOT EXISTS` and is quick. Also added a feature-flag guard for the tracing hook, so we can toggle if needed. I noted rollout plan in the PR description.

jae: Can you add a screenshot of the dashboard widgets in the PR? hard to reason about spacing/labels from code alone. Also any perf numbers for the tracing hook?

maria: Screenshot uploaded in the PR (see files tab). Perf: measured ~1-2ms extra on the request path in staging, and widgets are read-only queries behind cache with a 30s TTL.

devops-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ — unit (88), lint, and e2e (120) green.

leah: I'll do a pass after stand, roughly 10:30 PT.

tom: left a tiny comment on the migration SQL suggesting `IF NOT EXISTS` wrap (for safety on retries) and one i18n key tweak for the panel title.

maria: pushed fixes for both. thanks for the quick review notes.

sre-anna: quick security pass — tracing hook only attaches `request_id` header, no PII, logs sanitized. Suggest adding a line in ops runbook about troubleshooting traces (where to look).

maria: added runbook note and rebased onto main.

leah: Approved.

tom: Approved.

maria: Thanks everyone — merging in 30m if CI remains green. Will monitor metrics after deploy and roll back if we see any regression :rocket:

leah: Thanks — will watch dashboards post-merge.

maria: (merge done) Deployed to staging, monitoring. No regressions so far.

maria: (after 45m) Production deploy complete, dashboards reporting, traces linked to request_id. Closing PR. :tada:
